fabricColorMatch.en: Fabric colors match the original sample

fabricWeightMatch.en: Fabric weight matches the original sample

embroideryColorMatch.en: Embroidery colors match the original sample

embroideryDimMatch.en: Embroidery dimensions match the original sample

printColorMatch.en: Printed colors match the original sample

printDimMatch.en: Print dimensions match the original sample

washTagMatch.en: Washing tags match the original sample

generalSizingMatch.en: General sizing matches the original sample

sleeveDimMatch.en: Sleeve dimensions match the sizing chart

packagingCardMatch.en: The packaging card matches the original sample

sizeChartHelp.en: Enter the measured value for each size you checked. Values more than 0.5" off standard are flagged automatically.
sizeChartHelp.zh: 请输入每个尺码的实测数值。与标准值相差超过 0.5 英寸将自动标记。

generalPhotosHelp.en: Front, back, stitching, overall condition, etc.
generalPhotosHelp.zh: 正面、背面、走线、整体状况等

tagPhotosHelp.en: Washing tag, hang tag, packaging card, barcode, etc.
tagPhotosHelp.zh: 水洗唛、吊牌、包装卡、条码等

issuesHelp.en: Log any defects or non-conformances found during this inspection.
issuesHelp.zh: 请记录本次检验中发现的任何缺陷或不合格项。

noIssues.en: No issues found during this inspection

submitSuccess.zh: 报告已成功提交并发送邮件。

submitError.en: Something went wrong submitting the report. Please try again.
submitError.zh: 提交报告时出错，请重试。

customNotesPlaceholder.en: Any other observations for this product
customNotesPlaceholder.zh: 本产品的其他观察记录

finalApprovalHelp.en: Clean, final photos for manager review and approval. These are separate from the supporting photos already attached to each check above.
finalApprovalHelp.zh: 供主管审核批准的最终照片，与上方各检查项已附的支持性照片分开。

referenceChartHelp.en: These are the approved standard measurements for this fit. Use them for reference while measuring.
referenceChartHelp.zh: 以下为该版型已批准的标准尺寸，供测量时参考。

resultReasonTolerance.en: One or more measurements are out of tolerance
resultReasonTolerance.zh: 存在超出公差的测量值

resultReasonMinor.zh: 发现3个或以上轻微问题

resultReasonMajor.en: One or more major/critical issues found
resultReasonMajor.zh: 存在1个或以上严重/紧急问题

noIssuesReason.zh: 未发现影响判定的问题

photoRequiredForFail.en: A photo is required for any check marked Fail
photoRequiredForFail.zh: 标记为不合格的检查项必须上传照片

validationIncomplete.en: Please complete all required items before submitting
validationIncomplete.zh: 请在提交前完成所有必填项目

selectFitRequired.en: Please select a fit and enter at least one measurement
selectFitRequired.zh: 请选择版型并至少输入一项测量值

allChecksRequired.en: Please mark Pass, Fail, or N/A for every check
allChecksRequired.zh: 请为每项检查选择合格、不合格或不适用

photoTooLarge.en: That photo could not be processed. Please try a different one.
photoTooLarge.zh: 该照片无法处理，请尝试其他照片。

manageDropdownsHelp.en: Add or remove options for Factory Code, Creator/Brand, and QA/QC Lead. Changes apply immediately for everyone using this app.
manageDropdownsHelp.zh: 添加或删除工厂代码、创作者/品牌方、QA/QC负责人的选项。更改将立即对所有使用此应用的人生效。

aqlFallbackNotice.en: No lot size was entered, so a simplified pass/fail rule was used.
aqlFallbackNotice.zh: 未输入批量，因此使用了简化的合格/不合格规则。

resultReasonAqlCritical.en: Critical defects exceed the AQL accept threshold
resultReasonAqlCritical.zh: 致命缺陷数量超出AQL合格标准

resultReasonAqlMajor.en: Major defects exceed the AQL accept threshold
resultReasonAqlMajor.zh: 严重缺陷数量超出AQL合格标准

resultReasonAqlMinor.en: Minor defects exceed the AQL accept threshold
resultReasonAqlMinor.zh: 轻微缺陷数量超出AQL合格标准

additionalIssuesHelp.en: Use this for any issue not already flagged in the sections above - not limited to tolerance or placement.
additionalIssuesHelp.zh: 用于记录上述各项检查中未涉及的其他问题，不限于公差或位置类问题。

severityGuideText.en: Minor: within tolerance - we'll accept it. Major: outside tolerance - that unit gets rejected and sent back to the factory to fix. Critical: the entire batch has the issue - the whole batch gets rejected and redone.
severityGuideText.zh: 轻微：在公差范围内——可以接受。严重：超出公差范围——该件产品将被判定不合格，退回工厂返修。致命：整批产品都存在该问题——整批将被判定不合格并要求返工重做。

photoRequiredForDefect.en: Each logged defect needs at least one photo
photoRequiredForDefect.zh: 每个已记录的缺陷都需要至少一张照片

descriptionRequiredForDefect.en: Each logged defect needs a description
descriptionRequiredForDefect.zh: 每个已记录的缺陷都需要填写描述

defectRequiredForFail.en: Log at least one defect for any check marked Fail
defectRequiredForFail.zh: 任何标记为不合格的检查项都需要至少记录一个缺陷

actualSpotCheckHelp.en: Record the percentage actually inspected - this may differ from the recommendation during busy periods.
actualSpotCheckHelp.zh: 请记录实际抽检的比例，繁忙时期可能与建议值不同。

needMoreInfoForRecommendation.en: Select a Creator and enter PO Quantity above to see the recommendation.
needMoreInfoForRecommendation.zh: 请在上方选择创作者并输入订单数量以查看建议。

manageCreatorTiersHelp.en: Set each creator's QA tier (1, 2, or 3). This feeds the AQL recommendation below.
manageCreatorTiersHelp.zh: 设置每个创作者的QA等级（1、2或3）。此设置将用于下方的AQL建议计算。

manageAqlTableHelp.en: For each Tier, Risk, and PO Size combination, set the recommended Point Check % range and Inspection Level.
manageAqlTableHelp.zh: 为每个等级、风险及订单规模组合设置建议的抽检比例范围及检验水平。

manageUnitCostsHelp.en: Rough per-unit cost used to estimate PO order value (PO Quantity x unit cost), which determines the PO Size band above.
manageUnitCostsHelp.zh: 用于估算订单价值（订单数量 x 单件成本）的大致单件成本，从而确定上方的订单规模区间。

defaultTierLabel.zh: 默认等级（适用于未列出的创作者）

aqlNeedLotSize.en: Enter a PO quantity above to calculate the required sample size and AQL thresholds.
aqlNeedLotSize.zh: 请在上方输入订单数量以计算所需样本数量及AQL标准。

aqlPreProductionNotice.en: Pre-Production Sample: formal sampling thresholds don't apply here. Check a few units by hand, at least one of each size, using the same sections below.
aqlPreProductionNotice.zh: 产前样品：此处不适用正式抽样标准。请手动检查少量样品（每个尺码至少一件），并按照下方相同的检查项目进行。

preProductionQuantityHelp.en: How many units did you physically check by hand?
preProductionQuantityHelp.zh: 您实际手动检查了多少件产品？

recommendationReferenceTitle.zh: 建议抽检比例及参考标准

actualDeterminationTitle.zh: 实际标准（根据检查件数计算）

resultReasonAllRejected.zh: 所检查的产品全部被判定为不合格

enterActualSpotCheckFirst.en: Enter the actual spot check % below to see the real Accept/Reject thresholds that will determine pass/fail.
enterActualSpotCheckFirst.zh: 请在下方输入实际抽检比例，以查看决定合格/不合格的实际标准。

actualSpotCheckRequired.en: Actual Spot Check % is required for a Production Sample
actualSpotCheckRequired.zh: 量产样品必须填写实际抽检比例

toleranceGuidancePlush.en: Placeholder guidance: general dimensions (height, width) should be within about ±0.5 in of the approved sample. Please confirm the real tolerance with your team.
toleranceGuidancePlush.zh: 占位参考：整体尺寸（高度、宽度）应与已批准样品相差不超过约0.5英寸。请与团队确认真实公差标准。

toleranceGuidanceBags.en: Placeholder guidance: overall dimensions should be within about ±0.5 in of the approved sample; strap/handle length within about ±0.25 in. Please confirm the real tolerance with your team.
toleranceGuidanceBags.zh: 占位参考：整体尺寸应与已批准样品相差不超过约0.5英寸；背带/提手长度相差不超过约0.25英寸。请与团队确认真实公差标准。

toleranceGuidanceAccessories.en: Placeholder guidance: dimensions should be within about ±0.125 in of the approved sample. Please confirm the real tolerance with your team.
toleranceGuidanceAccessories.zh: 占位参考：尺寸应与已批准样品相差不超过约0.125英寸。请与团队确认真实公差标准。

toleranceGuidanceOther.en: No standard tolerance defined yet for this category - use your judgment and compare against the approved sample.
toleranceGuidanceOther.zh: 该类别尚无标准公差参考，请凭经验并与已批准样品进行比对。

actualUnitsCheckedHelp.en: Enter how many units you actually inspected. The percentage of the PO is calculated automatically.
actualUnitsCheckedHelp.zh: 请输入实际检查的件数，占订单总数的百分比将自动计算。

minorDefinition.zh: 在公差范围内——可以接受。

majorDefinition.en: Outside tolerance - that unit is rejected and sent back to the factory to fix. The rest of the batch isn't automatically rejected.
majorDefinition.zh: 超出公差范围——该件产品判定不合格，退回工厂返修。其余批次不会因此自动判定不合格。

criticalDefinition.en: The entire batch has this issue - the whole batch is rejected and must be redone. Zero tolerance.
criticalDefinition.zh: 整批产品都存在该问题——整批将被判定不合格并要求返工重做。零容忍。

resultReasonAllRejected.zh: 所检查的产品全部被判定为不合格

moreEarlierReports.en: earlier report(s) also exist for this PO

homeReportsDesc.en: Search and download full reports by SKU
homeReportsDesc.zh: 按SKU搜索并下载完整报告

chooserHelp.zh: 请选择您要进行的操作。

chooserNewPODesc.en: Log a new PO and get a link to share for QA/QC Approval
chooserNewPODesc.zh: 创建新采购订单并获取用于质检审批的分享链接

chooserPreProdDesc.en: Inspect a small hand-checked sample before the full run
chooserPreProdDesc.zh: 在量产前对少量手动检查的样品进行检验

chooserBulkDesc.en: Inspect a spot-checked sample of the full production run
chooserBulkDesc.zh: 对量产批次进行抽样检验

sizesInPoHelp.en: Select which sizes are part of this order - only these will show up later when adding photos or measurements.
sizesInPoHelp.zh: 请选择该订单包含的尺码——之后添加照片或测量数据时，只会显示这些尺码。

noEstablishedFitYet.en: No sizing standard is on file yet for this SKU. It'll be set during QA/QC Approval and copied forward automatically to future POs.
noEstablishedFitYet.zh: 该SKU尚无已建立的尺寸标准。该标准将在质检审批阶段设定，并自动应用于以后的订单。

shareLinkTitle.en: Share this link for QA/QC Approval
shareLinkTitle.zh: 请分享此链接以进行质检审批

poNotFound.en: Purchase order not found - has it been created via New Purchase Order?
poNotFound.zh: 未找到该采购订单——是否已通过“新建采购订单”创建？

priorSampleApprovalHelp.en: A completed Sample Approval already exists for this product
priorSampleApprovalHelp.zh: 该产品已有完整的样品审批记录

copiedFromPrior.en: Copied from prior PO - review and submit
copiedFromPrior.zh: 已从往期订单复制——请检查后提交

notReadyForReview.en: This stage hasn't been submitted by the Juniper China team yet - check back once it's ready for review.
notReadyForReview.zh: 此阶段尚未由Juniper中国团队提交，请稍后再来查看。

submitApprovalPhotosDesc.en: For the Juniper China team - upload photos and notes
submitApprovalPhotosDesc.zh: 供Juniper中国团队使用——上传照片和备注

pdReviewDesc.en: For Product Development - review and approve
pdReviewDesc.zh: 供产品开发团队使用——审核并批准

noSampleApprovalYet.en: Sample Approval hasn't been completed for this PO yet.
noSampleApprovalYet.zh: 该订单尚未完成样品审批。

commentRequiredFields.en: Please select your name and enter a comment
commentRequiredFields.zh: 请选择姓名并输入备注内容

prefilledFromPoNotice.en: Filled in from the Purchase Order and QA/QC Approval - double check and edit anything that's changed.
prefilledFromPoNotice.zh: 已根据采购订单和质检审批自动填写——如有变动请检查并修改。

approvalSizingReferenceTitle.zh: 尺寸信息（来自质检审批）

noPosForSku.en: No purchase orders found for this SKU.
noPosForSku.zh: 未找到该SKU对应的采购订单。

customSizeChartHelp.en: Fill in each approved size and its measurements. If it's faster, snap a photo of a paper chart below instead (or in addition).
customSizeChartHelp.zh: 请填写每个已批准的尺码及其测量数据。如果更方便，也可以在下方拍摄纸质表格照片代替（或补充）。

customSizeNamePlaceholder.zh: 例如 成人 M 码

customSizeMeasurementsPlaceholder.zh: 例如：胸围24英寸，衣长30英寸，袖长22英寸

chartPhotoHelp.en: A photo of the full approved size chart, if you have one on paper.
chartPhotoHelp.zh: 如有纸质版已批准尺寸表，请在此拍照上传。

prefilledNotice.en: Filled in from the Pre-Production report for this PO - double check and edit anything that's changed.
prefilledNotice.zh: 已根据该订单的产前样品报告自动填写——如有变动请检查并修改。

manageFitsHelp.en: Pick a standard to edit its chart, or add a new one. Values can be a single number or a range like 24-26.
manageFitsHelp.zh: 选择一个标准以编辑其尺寸表，或添加新标准。数值可以是单个数字，也可以是范围，例如 24-26。

fitKeyLabel.zh: 标识（内部使用，不含空格）

fitKeyPlaceholder.en: auto-generated from label if left blank
fitKeyPlaceholder.zh: 留空则根据名称自动生成

overallStatsTitle.zh: 总体统计（全部订单，按类别）
